name: Resident Spouse Permit

qualifying_event.description: A non-Bahamian spouse of a Bahamian citizen, married less than 5 years and residing together, may apply for an annual Resident Spouse Permit.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of cohabitation; spouse's Bahamian citizenship documents.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage to a Bahamian citizen, married less than 5 years at time of application, residing together.
This specific permit applies only while married less than 5 years; after 5 years the spouse instead applies for an extension of this permit, citizenship, or permanent residency.

evidence_required.document: Bahamian spouse's passport, birth certificate, employment letter
Birth certificates for children under 18 (from the marriage or otherwise)

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable until the 5-year marriage mark

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Resident Spouse Permit: for non-Bahamian spouses married less than 5 years, $200 processing fee, extensive document list, dependents apply separately for Permit to Reside

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. This is the FIRST-STAGE spousal status, distinct from and prior to bs_permanent_residence_marriage.json (available after 5 years of marriage) and bs_citizenship_by_marriage.json (Form I, restricted to female spouses only -- see that file's notes). Work rights modelled as 'restricted' since the source does not explicitly confirm unrestricted work authorisation under this specific permit; not confirmed either way on this source, flagged as an inference from the general pattern of dependent/spousal permits in this dataset.
